facts_quote_for_mention.name: facts_quote_for_mention
facts_quote_for_mention.value: "facts"."mention_id" is null or "facts"."quote" is not null

facts_text_quote_verified.name: facts_text_quote_verified
facts_text_quote_verified.value: "facts"."mention_id" is null or ("facts"."quote_verified" and "facts"."quote_chunk_id" is not null)

facts_text_extraction_run.name: facts_text_extraction_run
facts_text_extraction_run.value: "facts"."mention_id" is null or "facts"."extraction_run_id" is not null

facts_text_quote_span.name: facts_text_quote_span
facts_text_quote_span.value: "facts"."mention_id" is null or ("facts"."quote_start" is not null and "facts"."quote_end" is not null and "facts"."quote_start" >= 0 and "facts"."quote_start" < "facts"."quote_end")

ai_batches_sending_claim.name: ai_batches_sending_claim
ai_batches_sending_claim.value: "ai_batches"."status"::text <> 'sending' or ("ai_batches"."claim_id" is not null and "ai_batches"."claimed_at" is not null and "ai_batches"."lease_until" is not null)

profile_summaries_ok_complete.name: profile_summaries_ok_complete
profile_summaries_ok_complete.value: "profile_summaries"."status" <> 'ok' OR ("profile_summaries"."prompt_version" IS NOT NULL AND "profile_summaries"."text" IS NOT NULL)

delivered_objects_public_id_prefix.name: delivered_objects_public_id_prefix
delivered_objects_public_id_prefix.value: "delivered_objects"."public_id" ~ ('^' || CASE "delivered_objects"."object_type" WHEN 'spot' THEN 'sp' WHEN 'highlight' THEN 'hl' ELSE 'rg' END || '_')
